name: sandbox-create-open-not-granted
about: Open network asked for on a target that enforces an allow list: the sandbox starts with what it got, and networkNote says what differs, why and what would give it.

response.isolationMeans: a hardened container on the host's kernel

networkNote.fix: list what the sandbox must reach in network.allow (within your org's ceiling; POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/network/allow adds more later), or choose isolation sealed or vault, whose targets give an open network through the host egress gateway; send network.strict true to have such a create refused instead
networkNote.why: network.open was asked for and not given: runc enforces its allow list inside the sandbox, which this node does not open to the whole internet; this sandbox on runc reaches nothing outside it (no allow list was given)
